0022600132.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 4th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back) host the Miami Heat (0-4, 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 3 games back), with Atlanta on a one-game losing streak and Miami on a four-game skid. The Hawks are 0-1 at home and 2-0 on the road, and Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (fractured foot) are both out. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost 1-3 to Miami, including a 143-117 loss in Miami on April 12, 2026.
